text:
Priya (Finance): Received invoice from SunRidge NL. They charged 0% VAT and note 'reverse charge', but also emailed asking for a gross-up because they think US payments will be subject to withholding. Anyone want to weigh in?

invoice-bot: New invoice #SR-5511 1801239988 received 04/02/26 EUR 6,300 vendor VAT: NL445566778B02

Owen (Vendor Ops): Common confusion. Need to confirm billed entity. If billed to Redwood B.V. and paid from NL/EU, reverse charge applies. Gross-up only makes sense if payment from Redwood Inc triggers withholding.

Claire (Tax): Short answer: we do not gross-up automatically. Ask vendor to either: (A) reissue to Redwood B.V. for reverse-charge; or (B) provide W-8BEN-E + a written gross-up calculation and contract clause if they insist on net payment when paid from US. Also request their VAT registration extract.

Maya (Accounting): Invoice details:
```
Invoice: SR-5511
Date: 2026-04-01
Billed to: (blank)
Amount: EUR 6,300
VAT: 0% reverse charge (vendor VAT NL445566778B02)
```

Priya (Finance): I'll send this template reply: "Please confirm billed entity and supply VAT registration extract. If Redwood Inc will pay and you expect no withholding, submit W-8BEN-E. We cannot gross-up without contract reference and a calculation. Payment is on hold until docs received." Good?

Owen (Vendor Ops): Add: ask where services were performed. If services performed in US, sourcing could change withholding position.

Claire (Tax): Good point. Also: if they send a gross-up calc, tag Legal before approving.

invoice-bot: Payment hold set: missing tax docs 1801240005

Priya (Finance): Thanks all. I'll send now and mark ticket. :thumbsup:
